verdict.rationale: Every documented Figma Make capability (chats, attachments, code editing, version history, annotations, publishing) is a UI feature, and no public Make API is documented. A hands-on community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, forcing the user to reverse-engineer the binary format. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. The MCP mention is client-side (pulling context from other apps), not API access to Make itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
